title: Sharp Complete Modified Log-Sobolev Inequalities on Classical and Quantum Tori
summary: We prove that the heat semigroup on the circle has optimal complete modified logarithmic Sobolev constant \(1\). The proof is based on a matrix-valued Wirtinger inequality and yields the stronger Bogoliubov--Kubo--Mori Fisher information contraction with rate \(e^{-2t}\). As a consequence, the complete tensorization and transference principle yields the same sharp constant for the heat semigroups on classical and quantum tori.
